instruction: Change the line spacing of the first paragraph to double spacing (2.0), then save the file

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing line spacing of first paragraph to double spacing (2.0). Evaluator extracts line spacing value from first non-empty paragraph and checks if it equals 2.0 within tolerance of 0.1.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts line spacing from first non-empty paragraph using python-docx library
Metric correctly compares result vs expected (2.0) with appropriate tolerance (0.1) for float comparison
Expected value (2.0) correctly represents double spacing as required by instruction
Data flow is correct: getter retrieves saved file from VM, extracts line spacing, metric compares against expected value
Instruction mentions 'save the file' - verification implicitly checks this because getter retrieves file from VM after user action, so if line spacing is 2.0, the file must have been saved
Postconfig (1-second sleep) appropriately allows LibreOffice Writer to complete save operation
Edge cases handled: returns default 1.0 if file not found or no line spacing set, skips empty paragraphs
